title: Daniel's Vision of Four Beasts

questions.question: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, what did Daniel see?
options: A dream and visions of his head
A hand writing on the wall
questions.correctAnswer: A dream and visions of his head
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:1 (ESV): "In the first year of Belshazzar... Daniel saw a dream and visions of his head as he lay in his bed."

questions.question: How many great beasts came up out of the sea?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:3 (ESV): "And four great beasts came up out of the sea, different from one another."

questions.question: The first beast was like a lion and had what kind of wings?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:4 (ESV): "The first was like a lion and had eagles' wings."

questions.question: The Ancient of Days took his seat; his clothing was white as what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:9 (ESV): "the Ancient of Days took his seat; his clothing was white as snow,"

questions.question: Who came with the clouds of heaven and was presented before the Ancient of Days?
options: One like a son of man
questions.correctAnswer: One like a son of man
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:13 (ESV): "and behold, with the clouds of heaven there came one like a son of man,"

questions.question: The second beast was like a bear and had how many ribs in its mouth between its teeth?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:5 (ESV): "And behold, another beast, a second one, like a bear... It had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth;"

questions.question: The third beast was like a leopard and had how many wings and heads?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:6 (ESV): "another, like a leopard, with four wings... on its back, and the beast had four heads,"

questions.question: The fourth beast had ten horns. What came up among them?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:8 (ESV): "I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one,"

questions.question: What was given to the one like a son of man?
options: Dominion and glory and a kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: Dominion and glory and a kingdom
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:14 (ESV): "And to him was given dominion and glory and a kingdom,"

questions.question: The four beasts represent four what that shall arise out of the earth?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:17 (ESV): "These four great beasts are four kings who shall arise out of the earth."

questions.question: The saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom and possess it for how long?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:18 (ESV): "But the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom and possess the kingdom forever, forever and ever."

questions.question: How long shall the saints be given into the hand of the little horn?
options: A time, times, and half a time
questions.correctAnswer: A time, times, and half a time
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:25 (ESV): "and they shall be given into his hand for a time, times, and half a time."

questions.question: The fourth beast was different from all the rest, exceedingly terrifying, with teeth of iron and claws of what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:19 (ESV): "with its teeth of iron and claws of bronze,"

questions.question: What happened to the first horn roots when the little horn came up?
options: Three of them were plucked up by the roots
questions.correctAnswer: Three of them were plucked up by the roots
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:8 (ESV): "before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots."

questions.question: After the court sits in judgment, the dominion of the little horn shall be taken away to be what?
options: Consumed and destroyed to the end
questions.correctAnswer: Consumed and destroyed to the end
questions.explanation: Daniel 7:26 (ESV): "But the court shall sit in judgment, and his dominion shall be taken away, to be consumed and destroyed to the end."

key_verse_text: I saw in the night visions, and behold, with the clouds of heaven there came one like a son of man... And to him was given dominion and glory and a kingdom, that all peoples, nations, and languages should serve him; his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom one that shall not be destroyed.
